budget.enforcement_description: The agent is passed this token_budget and stops issuing further model requests once its accumulated input+output+cache tokens reach it. This bounds the overshoot to at most one in-flight agent step's token usage and does not cover Terminus-2's rare context-length-exceeded fallback path, which can call the model directly. See go_explore/agents/token_budget.py.
